results.message: Compare the tallest building in Birmingham with the tallest in Manchester: give both names, both heights in metres, and by how many metres one is taller.
results.answer:

Manchester’s tallest is Deansgate Square South Tower at 200.5 metres. ([skyscrapercenter.com](https://www.skyscrapercenter.com/index.php/city/manchester))

results.message: Who won the Booker Prize in each of the last three years, and which of those three books is the shortest?
results.answer:
The Booker Prize winners were:

2025: David Szalay, for *Flesh*. ([thebookerprizes.com](https://thebookerprizes.com/media-centre/press-releases/flesh-by-david-szalay-wins-the-booker-prize-2025))  
2024: Samantha Harvey, for *Orbital*. ([thebookerprizes.com](https://thebookerprizes.com/the-booker-library/prize-years/2024))  
2023: Paul Lynch, for *Prophet Song*. ([thebookerprizes.com](https://thebookerprizes.com/the-booker-library/prize-years/2023))

The Seven Moons of Maali Almeida by Shehan Karunatilaka is listed as 400 pages in the publisher’s U.S. and Indian editions. I didn’t find a reliable word-count listing. ([penguin.co.in](https://www.penguin.co.in/book/the-seven-moons-of-maali-almeida/))

The Promise by Damon Galgut varies by edition: 256 pages for the U.S. hardcover and 272 pages for the U.S. paperback. ([target.com](https://www.target.com/p/-/A-85673729))

Orbital by Samantha Harvey is 144 pages in the U.K. edition; Grove Atlantic lists 224 pages for its U.S. hardcover and paperback. ([penguin.co.uk](https://www.penguin.co.uk/books/454068/orbital-by-harvey-samantha/9781529922936))
